image_description: A grand, ornate pipe organ installed within a highly decorated church interior featuring Baroque-style frescoes and architectural moldings. The organ features multiple tiers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, arranged in symmetrical groups with decorative wooden casework. The structure is integrated into the arched alcove of the building.

To assess general texture consistency and look for subtle AI-generation artifacts in the complex ornamental details.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the regularity of the pipe diameters and spacing. AI generators often struggle with repeating geometric patterns, leading to slight warping or inconsistent spacing in long rows of pipes. Also, verify if the ornate carvings maintain logical structural connectivity or if they appear to 'melt' into the background.
